voiceover.text: Your car doesn't have a transmission dipstick? You're not imagining things.
A lot of newer transmissions are sealed for life — no dipstick, by design.
The fluid level gets checked at a fill plug, usually from underneath, on a lift.
Some also need the fluid at a specific temperature to get an accurate reading.
Fluid looks dark or smells burnt? That's worth checking before it becomes a bigger repair.
Nick's Tire and Auto — stop by and we'll take a look.

caption: No dipstick under the hood for your transmission? You're not imagining it — a lot of newer transmissions are sealed for life. The fluid gets checked at a fill plug, sometimes at a specific temperature. Dark or burnt-smelling fluid is worth checking before it turns into a bigger repair. Nick's Tire & Auto, 17625 Euclid Ave, Cleveland — stop by and we'll take a look.
